title: CSJM Kanpur University Provisional Certificate Online Form 2021
organization: Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://csjmu.ac.in or student portal
2. Open Examination / Provisional Certificate apply
3. Login with enrollment / roll number
4. Fill form, pay fee if required
5. Download provisional certificate when approved
shortDescription: CSJM Kanpur University Provisional Certificate Online Form – apply and download provisional degree from university portal.
content:
CSJM University Kanpur students can apply online for provisional certificates / degrees after result declaration.

Use the official student / examination portal, pay the prescribed fee, and download the provisional document for higher studies or jobs until the original degree is issued.
